title: Item 809 reopened: the guard hook's start_session matcher makes the desktop app show the card
ruling: Owner, typed in the triage chat 00:12 CST Nov 14: "Reopen 809." Fix: remove mcp__ccd_session__start_session from the PreToolUse matcher in settings.json, with no regex matcher; keep the start checks some other way that adds no PreToolUse hook on that tool, and say which is chosen and which checks are lost; add a settings test, red first; record the decision that start_session is not gated at PreToolUse. Cause proven by the owner's test at 00:04 CST Nov 14 (card with the matcher, none without it); app issue anthropics/claude-code#103832. Supersedes ruling own-809-let-go ("a bug on the app, let it go"). Triage did not check the app code path.
